title: Body phase redirects
statement: Given Boolean-alphabet machines $M_V$ and $M_I$, define a phase transition map on the body phases test, clear, and increment. It sends the test phase's false-verdict exit to the clear phase's sweep state, the clear phase's exit to the increment phase's run state, and the increment phase's true-verdict exit to the test phase's anchor state; every other phase-state pair has no redirect.
